calculation.description: Ranks tradable assets by negative trailing five-session return normalized by trailing 20-session daily volatility. The one-session lag ensures only completed data are used.

validation.period: 2026-07-16 through 2027-02-25 (available historical rows in runtime API)
validation.regime_notes: Runtime sample produced 111 valid 2025-26 observations with IC 0.0272923 and 38 valid 2027 observations with IC -0.06943634; pre-2025 regime buckets had no valid observations in this API pull. Interpret the small and recent sample conservatively.
